artifacts.description: feat(sketch): name redundant constraints in the DOF report

acceptance_criteria: A sketch-level call, e.g. `Sketch::dof(options: DofOptions) -> Result<SketchDofReport, SolveError>`, returns the `DofReport` fields plus `redundant_constraints: Vec<ConstraintId>`. That list is the distinct constraints that own at least one redundant row, ascending, with no duplicates.
Alternatively or additionally, a public `Sketch::constraint_of_row(row: usize) -> Option<ConstraintId>`.

Tests: (a) the plate sketch (`plate_sketch` example constraints), solved: `FullyConstrained`, and `redundant_constraints` is empty; (b) plus a top-line distance of 40: `OverConstrained`, and `redundant_constraints == [id of that distance]`; (c) with 45 instead, after solve: `Conflicting`, with the same id; (d) a duplicate `Coincident` (2 rows) is reported once.
No new dependencies; `swx-sketch` still doesn't depend on `swx-kernel`; no `unsafe`.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` passes.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M2-05a: DOF report names the conflicting constraints (ConstraintIds), not just residual rows
